spans.s: --the place of Budha in the मण्डलम्. वा. ५३. ७४.
--three, प्राकृत, वैकारिक and दक्षिण, which have their origin in ignorance. वा. १०२. ५९, ६०.

--jail; escaping from and letting one to do so will be punished;
1: M. २२७. २०८-10.
also बन्धस्थानम्।
2: Ib. २५६. ३५.
(I)--the son of Vegavat and father of तृण- bindu. भा.
(II)--a God of one of the ten branches of the रोहीता gan2a. Br.
--son of कुशाल (कुनाल-वा। प्।) (Mau- rya)--ruled for 8 years. Br. III. ७४. १४६. वा. ९९. ३३३.
(I)--a son of Kevala and father of Vegavat. भा.
